versions.changelog: Corrected the English romanization of city and neighborhood names using authoritative reading data; moved per-trip driving routes to a companion file for a lighter download.
Reworked commuter-to-workplace matching to reproduce census commute totals exactly; recomputed map geometry in the map's local projection for accurate shapes and a lighter download.

Refreshed maps onto the full modeling pipeline (foundations, bathymetry, 3D heights, land use, military demand); restored dropped coastal and island neighborhoods and corrected on-base resident counts.
Added military-base demand and expanded special-demand and point seeding for the Ōsaka and Fukuoka maps.
Switched to Overture building data and stitched buildings and water into tiles for lighter rendering.
Trimmed demand-data size for lighter, smoother maps.
Reduced the buildings download size and pruned tiny building fragments.
Initial release of the Ōsaka map with census-based residents and workers, commute demand, and university, zoo, aquarium, and school demand.
